messages:
Priya Infra: FYI capacity update: current H100 allocation for EU pool was reduced by 20% for Q2. this shipment is critical for upcoming bench runs. tagging procurement + vendor.
Sam Procurement: @Luca any visibility on lead times? PO PO-6621 still says "2-3 weeks" but vendor portal shows 6 weeks now. pricing held? we need to lock.
Luca (Vendor): sorry — OEM reallocated some wafers, ETAs slipped. for PO-6621 we can keep unit price at $28,000 if you accept partial fulfillment now (6 units) and remainder later. lead for rest is ~5 weeks.
Priya Infra: partial fill helps but we need at least 8 in EU region to run validation. can you prioritize EU routing vs APAC? any extra expedite delta?
Luca (Vendor): we can reroute 2 units from APAC stock to EU for $950/unit expedite + $600 handling. that would get you to 8. total expedite delta = $2,500.
Emma Logistics: customs note: mixing AWBs increases broker fees. if you split shipments we'll incur two clearance fees (~$420 each). consolidation avoids that but depends on carrier cutoffs.
Sam Procurement: math check: vendor expedite $2,500 vs broker duplicate fees if split (~$840) + time risk. also need to account for potential RMA for DOA. any DOA history on last batch?
Luca (Vendor): last batch DOA rate was ~0.7%. low but not zero. we accept RMAs within 30d. we can add 1-year advance replacement SLA for this PO at no extra unit cost if you sign amended terms.
Priya Infra: that's attractive. can we get the SLA in writing and an expedited RMA pickup window (24-48h) for EU? that reduces risk for validation schedule.
Luca (Vendor): yes, will draft amendment: AdvanceReplace clause + 48h pickup in EU hubs. I'll attach to the invoice amendment.
Emma Logistics: practical ask: if we accept partial and expedite 2 units, update the ship docs to include customs invoice ref `PO-6621-EU` and consignee EORI `NL123456789B01`. otherwise customs will delay.
Sam Procurement: Luca pls confirm invoice id you'll amend and whether expedite delta can be invoiced separately as "expedite charge". we want clean accounting.
Luca (Vendor): will issue Invoice `INV-7754-A` with line items: 6 units, 2 expedited units (charged), and amendment credit for SLA. expedite will be separate.
RMA Bot: Note: If DOA detected, create RMA with tag `RMA-EXPRESS` for EU hub to trigger 48h pickup.
Priya Infra: quick ask on pricing: if we take full commitment for next quarter (25 units), can we get a 3% volume discount? budgeting asks.
Luca (Vendor): 3% for 25u is doable but requires a 60% deposit. alternative: 1.5% on net 30 without deposit.
Sam Procurement: prefer 1.5% net30. I'll approve if legal ok. Priya, are you comfortable with net30?
Priya Infra: yes net30 ok. secure the 1.5% and the advance-replace SLA in the amendment. also flag the 2 expedited units booking once docs updated.
Emma Logistics: once Luca provides AWB and consolidated packing list, we'll schedule clearance. don't auto-clear until docs match consignee/EORI.
Luca (Vendor): sending AWB `FF-88012345` and consolidated packing list now. will attach amendment PDF and updated invoice by EOD.
Sam Procurement: thanks. I'll hold approval until amendment and invoice arrive. Priya, Emma keep me posted on customs hold risk.
Priya Infra: will monitor and report back. if RMA triggers we'll use RMA-EXPRESS path. thanks all.
